nodes.label: Frozen copy taken 2026-08-03 of the desktop machine's memory file - the live directory sits on the other machine and is not reachable from here, so this copy is what there is to review. Listed unreviewed in REVIEW_REGISTER.md section 6. When the user and the agent converge on a concept - a design, a formula, a mechanism - state it once in plain words and then KEEP that phrasing; do not restate it in new jargon, new metaphors or new parameterizations in later messages, the way 'max' became 'dot product' became 'pairwise multiply and sum' for the same step. Each rename reads as if the implementation changed mid-conversation, and the user cannot tell renamed-same from actually-different, so trust collapses and he has to re-interrogate settled ground. After sign-off, refer to the mechanism by the same short name every time; if the implementation genuinely must change, say explicitly that this CHANGES what was agreed, and what moved. CANON_AUDIT.md lists this among the grounded, verbatim-quoted and correct desktop entries
